selectors.safeLoaderConvention: Existing loader first checks approved process env, then exact find-generic-password service/account/label, value returned only into process and never logged. All lookup errors become RECEIVING_CREDENTIAL_REQUIRED. No broad search or alternate service/SMTP fallback.
selectors.registrationEvidence: READINESS.json records lastHostMetadataLookupStatus0 and exact triple; README explicitly corrects old PREFLIGHT service OTR-QA-Inbound to service OTR_QA_RESEND_API_KEY/label OTR-QA-Inbound. No current key query performed.
selectors.reportedErrorLimit: MCP parameter-invalid/not-found reports do not prove a different registered selector. Cannot distinguish command invocation syntax, access/keychain context or missing item from static code; do not mutate selectors or search arbitrary items.

reservation.createChallenge: Builds exact recipient/requestedAt lease; synchronously calls config.reserve(metadata) before returning challenge. It does not itself acquire/check registered-native04 active.lock. If reserve throws, challenge is not returned; do not try same receiver again to evade rejection.
reservation.wait: waitForOtp requires same object identity as returned challenge, single consumption, exact recipient/time/sender/subject and bounded reads.
reservation.existingHostWrapper: withRegisteredQaHostSession exclusively mkdirs /private/tmp/otr-hosted-otp-qa/registered-native04/active.lock BEFORE factory use. Any already-existing lock is REGISTERED_HOST_UNRESOLVED_OR_CONCURRENT_RUN, without special same-owner reentry. Its reserve checks protected last-request.json and60second cooldown, records CHALLENGE_RESERVED_BEFORE_NORMAL_HOST_SEND, writes reservation0600 before normal send. Finally releases only after owncleanup or no attempted request.
reservation.oldNativeWrapper: openRegisteredNativeReloginReceiver is old fixed interruptedNative case; reserve O_EXCL/NOFOLLOW writes auth-native-relogin-once.json+fsync under original case/window. Not a fresh-browser attach API.
reservation.existingLegalInvocationLimit: Factory accepts a REAL owner-supplied synchronous reserve callback; only valid if current MCP lease owner actually exposes a verified admission/reservation operation that durably binds this exact email/requestedAt/new-browser challenge, one-shot budget/cooldown, activelease ownership and current scope before UI send. A no-op, second host wrapper, foreign Session or deleting/replacing active.lock is not valid.
reservation.actualGap: Inspected Auth helpers expose no attach/reentrant API to admit a browser challenge onto MCP normalcontrol registeredNative04 active lease. No static code for that particular MCP owner was supplied/found in targeted Auth callers; cannot certify its own-reservation behavior. Parent should obtain exact MCP lease-owning admission function/path; if absent, minimal owning caller adapter is needed, preserving existing lock/cooldown/one-shot scope. No need to invent new authority or bypass guard.
